description.value: Griffin Pub is a neighbourhood institution near CFB Comox on Kilmorley Road, serving traditional pub fare and local BC craft beer since 1984. With 16 taps, house wines from Chabberton Estate in Langley, and a seasonal menu built around Comox Valley produce, it draws a loyal local crowd. A connected liquor store, patio seating, live music on Fridays, poker nights, and weekly trivia make it a lively full-evening destination.
